title: An Integrated Machine Learning Framework for Developing and Validating a Diagnostic Model of Hub Genes Related to Lipid Metabolism in Chronic Rhinosinusitis.
summary: The primary full text supports the case-specific result: Integrated analysis identified lipid-metabolism genes and validated a diagnostic model for chronic rhinosinusitis. The result is reported in Journal of Inflammation Research. The study does not establish generalization beyond its reported setting or prospective real-world benefit.
ai_technology: A combined random-forest and stepwise generalized-linear-model diagnostic classifier selected six genes from chronic-rhinosinusitis expression data; qRT-PCR and immunofluorescence checked expression of three genes.
organization: The First Affiliated Hospital of Chongqing Medical University

evidence.tested: The study identified 41 hub genes and developed a combined random-forest/stepwise-GLM six-gene diagnostic model with AUC 0.848. qRT-PCR and immunofluorescence confirmed higher RAB35, GLE1 and OSMR expression in chronic-rhinosinusitis samples than controls. Findings are cohort-specific and do not establish clinical benefit.
evidence.unknown: Independent replication and prospective real-world benefit are not established in the reviewed study.
evidence.ai_role: A combined random-forest and stepwise generalized-linear-model diagnostic classifier selected six genes from chronic-rhinosinusitis expression data; qRT-PCR and immunofluorescence checked expression of three genes.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
